name: Multiple simultaneous opposing action buttons
summary: Show only the control that applies in the current state; transform Send into Stop and guard against double clicks.
problem: Showing Send and Stop together forces users to work out which one is valid. One of them is always meaningless and invites wrong clicks.

bad.description: A composer with both a Stop button and a Send button visible at once.

good.title: One control that changes
good.description: Send before generation, Stop during it. Stop is briefly disabled after the swap so a repeated click does not cancel the request by accident. Try it.

why: Fewer visible controls, a clearer next step, and an interaction guard keeps the transformation safe.
exceptions: Both actions may be shown when both can really be used at the same time (Accept and Reject on a review item, Undo and Redo, Zoom in and Zoom out, Play and Next).

humanReview: Can both visible actions be used at the same time?
Is there a guard against an accidental repeat click after a control transforms?
